ollama.title: Ollama Setup Tutorial
ollama.subtitle: Connect Screenshot (App) Maker to your own Ollama instance so you fit use AI translate and generate text.
requirements: Mac, Windows PC, or Linux machine wey fit run Ollama
Ollama don install and e dey run
Your iPhone/iPad for the same network as the Ollama machine (we recommend this)
steps: Install Ollama: download and install Ollama for your OS.
Start Ollama: run ollama serve (or open the Ollama app on macOS).
Pull a model: run ollama pull llama3.2 (or any other model wey you prefer).
Confirm say e dey work: run ollama run llama3.2 and test a prompt.
Find your server address: note your computer's LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.0.10).
Use am for the app: inside Screenshot (App) Maker settings, set Host to http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: If the app no fit connect, check say your phone and computer dey on the same Wi‑Fi network.
Make sure say your firewall allow port 11434.
If you prefer to use remote server (home PC, VPS), you must expose the port securely (VPN recommended).
ollama.ctaBody: Go back to the app, test the connection, and start with one locale.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Dis Privacy Policy dey explain how Screenshot (App) Maker ("the App") dey handle user data.
summary: No accounts. No analytics. No tracking.
Your files and the things wey you edit go remain for your device, unless you decide say make you connect to your own Ollama server.
If you use Ollama, text go only go to the server address wey you set.

sections.title: Information Collection
body: The App no dey collect, save, or send any personal information go our servers.
Screenshots, templates, and images wey you export, dem dey create and save am for your own device.

sections.title: Access to Files and Photos
body: The App fit ask for permission to enter your Files app or your photo library so e go fit bring in screenshots.
Images wey you import, na for the device dem dey process am; dem no dey upload am automatically.

sections.title: AI Translation (Ollama)
body: If you turn on AI text generation or translation, the App fit send text go one Ollama server wey you set up (for example, your own computer).
We no dey run or collect your Ollama traffic, and the App no dey record or keep the text wey AI process.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
body: The App no dey use third-party analytics, advertising SDKs, or any technology wey dey track person.

sections.title: Changes
body: We fit change this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes go show for this page.

sections.title: Contact
body: If you get any question about this Privacy Policy, abeg contact us through the email address wey dey for the App Store listing.
